### CVE-2014-125026 — Out-of-bounds write in github.com/cloudflare/golz4
- Assigner: Go | Published: 2022-12-27 | Updated: 2025-04-11 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE 94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection'); CWE-787 CWE-787 Out-of-bounds Write
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

LZ4 bindings use a deprecated C API that is vulnerable to memory corruption, which could lead to arbitrary code execution if called with untrusted user input.
